candidates.title: Continuation / Base Pattern Family
candidates.evidence: Flag/Pennant/Triangle/Wedge/Platform/High Tight Flag already appear in pattern governance/System2 research, but no active D01 module owns the family.
candidates.proposal: Evaluate a new umbrella owner or explicit expansion of D01-07/D01-05; do not create separate modules per named pattern.

candidates.title: Closing Auction / Auction Imbalance
candidates.evidence: Microstructure research explicitly separates opening/closing auction, but active curriculum only names D05-06 opening auction.
candidates.proposal: Prefer expanding D05-06 to Opening/Closing Auction & Auction Imbalance rather than adding a new module.

candidates.title: Retail / Individual Investor Flow
candidates.evidence: Institutional, margin, lending, branch and ETF flows are covered, but retail/individual investor flow or residual retail order imbalance has no explicit owner.
candidates.proposal: Validate Taiwan observability first; if only residual-from-total proxy is available, keep research-only and do not infer motive.

candidates.title: Dividend / Payout Policy & Sustainability
candidates.evidence: Dividend event mechanics exist in D11 and capital allocation in D21, but payout ratio, dividend sustainability, payout policy and earnings/cash-flow coverage have no explicit fundamental owner.
candidates.proposal: Candidate new D07 fundamental module; event mechanics remain D11 and governance capital allocation remains D21.

candidates.title: Sales-based / Enterprise Multiples
candidates.evidence: PE/PB, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, DCF and peers exist; P/S and EV/Sales are not explicit.
candidates.proposal: Prefer broadening D08-06 or D08-02 into enterprise/sales multiples rather than a standalone module unless sector-specific evidence demands it.

candidates.title: Supply-chain Network Centrality / Single-point Failure / Resilience
candidates.evidence: Supply-chain map, asymmetry and issuer exposure exist, but network criticality, alternate sourcing, single-point-of-failure and resilience are not explicit.
candidates.proposal: Likely extend D10-01/D10-12; new module only if network topology has distinct data/decision contract.

candidates.title: Futures Term Structure / Calendar Spread / Roll Yield
candidates.evidence: Basis, OI, expiry and options term structure are covered, but futures curve/calendar-spread/roll-yield economics have no explicit owner.
candidates.proposal: Candidate new derivatives module if Taiwan futures historical curve data and replay contract are feasible.

candidates.title: Dependence-aware Resampling / Block Bootstrap
candidates.evidence: Stationary/block bootstrap already exists in D16 promotion-gate research but has no explicit curriculum owner.
candidates.proposal: Absorb into D16-06 Independent-Date/Date-cluster Inference rather than create a new module.

candidates.title: Multi-factor Benchmark Models
candidates.evidence: CAPM/Beta/Alpha and factor exposure exist, but Fama-French/Carhart/q-style multifactor benchmark construction is not explicit.
candidates.proposal: Extend D19-01 and/or D19-10; avoid duplicate standalone factor-model module unless benchmark construction has distinct validation needs.

candidates.title: Confirmation Bias / Belief Perseverance / Conservatism
candidates.evidence: Prospect theory, disposition, overconfidence, anchoring, representativeness, herding and attention are covered; biased belief updating/confirmation is not.
candidates.proposal: Prefer one umbrella belief-updating-bias module rather than separate confirmation/conservatism modules.

candidates.title: Shareholder Rights / Stewardship / Activism / Voting
candidates.evidence: Ownership, board, insiders, pledging, RPT and minority-shareholder risk are covered, but shareholder rights, proxy voting, stewardship and activism have no explicit owner.
candidates.proposal: Candidate governance module; keep event-specific tender/proxy mechanics outside if owned by D11.

candidates.title: Debt Seniority / Collateral / Recovery Waterfall
candidates.evidence: Covenant/default, capital structure and distress/recovery exist, but security priority, collateral and recovery waterfall are not explicit.
candidates.proposal: Prefer extending D22-12 Distress/Recovery and D22-07 Covenant/Default; add a new module only if instrument-level capital-structure data justifies it.
